name: session-workflow
description: Commands for ending a session well — /session-clean to record what the chat alone holds, and /handoff to carry it onward. /session-clean proposes where each loose end belongs and writes nothing unprompted; /handoff produces the document a fresh session starts from and, where the surface can start one, opens it directly. Ships transcript-digest.py, which reduces a transcript to the records worth keeping. Always on; depends on connector-conventions for filing through the GitHub connector and on delegation-conventions for the model a session it starts runs on.
